works.body:
Hello!
I would like to request a custom Pokemon card full-art of Feraligatr.
With an original character and Munkidori in it. Feel free to redesign her outfit to better fit the Pokemon Trainer aesthetic in your style.

Original Character reference: https://www.deviantart.com/saltinducedcoma/art/Salty-Spring-2021-876837939

It will serve as a fanmade proxy card for casual play, particularly this card: Feraligatr - SV05: Temporal Forces (TEF)041/162. The card details are optional!

I very much enjoy your artworks of HoloPoke fanmade cards! I also follow your animation work on YouTube!

I am so happy that you opened up skebs!!  I've been following you on twitter and love the journal style art you do for the hololive members. 

I would love a journal type entry artwork also. My model loves treasure, food, reading, gaming and adventuring out with friends. 

I'd like permission to use the artwork in a lore video and on SNS!

Thank you for considering my request!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/16wYs4vYn6VbsLRLDe6Ivg2thmWlXD0ja?usp=sharing

Hello I really love your art especially from your HoloPoké collab series you've done! I was wondering if you could do a full art Pokémon card of my Vtuber Rai and Luxray. Rai is a storm chaser, who is adventurous and really cool, he has some set of styles but I want his hair to be up please. As for poses and expressions I'll leave that to you! I would also like to share this on social platforms with credit. Thank you so much!!!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1nagKmVStDapWlQv1z7dcV92q_O8v69-C?usp=drive_link

Nice to meet you! I would like to request illustrations of Aiori, an original character in the Pokemon world, and my cat Ranya (Persian male in different color Alola).
Reference image: This is the folder -> https://sta.sh/2y0tsvh6n7z

Character details (as shown in the image "aiori ref sheet")
Aiori: Elegant and princess-like.
Aiori: She is elegant and has a princess-like aura. She likes fashion (Japanese clothes, Lolita clothes). Her personality is calm and collected, but in fact she is a bit childish and a bit tsundere.
She is very short (~145cm), but is actually an adult (~30s).
She has round eyebrows.
Makeup (lipstick and eye shadow, both in red)
Her hair length is ~ to her thighs and knees. Her hair is long, from her thighs to her knees, and her bangs are swirl shaped like "aiori hair" (similar to a Persian tail).
White eyepatch on right eye, red on left eye

→And Ran'ya (Persian) wears a pearl collar. Compared to Aiori, Ranya's size is like a tiger (she is a bit bigger than the other Persians)

▪ Expression, pose, and background
Aiori's expression is calm and almost expressionless. Ranya is left up to you (a little grin or something would be nice).
Aiori is sitting with Ranya in the pose and background as shown in the images "pose" and "background".
The background is a Taisho-romantic interior, and Aiori and Ranya are sitting on a red sofa like in the image "background". It would be nice to have a similar stained glass window in the back.
I'd like to have camellia flowers (red) scattered here and there to create a winter image.

Clothing: High-color, Taisho-roman style clothing.
Red kimono (preferably with a thin arrow-feather pattern).
Underneath the kimono is a high collar blouse with lace around the neck and a brooch (either a mega keystone or a single color is acceptable).
Off-white hakama (gold embroidery does not need to be so detailed).
Hakama with tassel-like golden monster ball-like ornaments (same as Ranya's collar).
Black fur shawl on the shoulder (red gradient or all black is fine)
Earrings (pearls)
Her charm point is a big red ribbon in her hair accessory.
Gold wedding ring on her left hand

https://sta.sh/2y0tsvh6n7z

Hello! May I request an illustration of Venus from Pokemon Colosseum? The piece should be in portrait and features Venus looking confident and smug. The character has very little references so I'm happy to let you draw your interpretation of her! I will leave the pose, composition, and background to your liking, so please have fun with it. Thanks!
